    else:  # Space rows with 1s
        row_types['space'].append((i, vals))

print("Row categories:")
for cat, items in sorted(row_types.items()):
    print(f"  {cat}: {len(items)} rows")

# Look at what's special about line rows
print("\nLine row details (showing non-5 values):")
for i, vals in row_types['line']:
    specials = [(c, v) for c, v in enumerate(vals) if v != 5]

        print(f"  Row {i}: {dict(specials)}")
